name: I Am Pet Doctor
summary:
Step into I Am Pet Doctor VR, a fun Meta Quest VR game where you become a caring pet doctor in a colorful cartoon animal hospital. Treat cute pets, use interactive doctor tools, complete pet care checkups, and enjoy immersive hands-on pet doctor gameplay designed for fans of animal care, doctor games, vet games, and VR simulator adventures.
